title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout, administrator installation requirement, control paths and package API calls are supported. Microsoft documents authentication differently on two pages; the briefing should acknowledge that discrepancy rather than present the authorization property name without qualification.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft 365 admin center installation path leads through Registry, the Available status filter, Install, audience selection and permission consent to Finish deployment.
claims.quote: Select Agents > All agents. ... make sure Registry is selected. Select the Status filter and then select Available. ... In the Permissions requested window, select Accept to grant the permissions to the agent, and then select Next.

acquireUsersAndGroups ... Users/groups for whom the package is deployed.
